verdict.rationale: Copilot acts on real connected services such as email, calendar and Drive, and takes actions in the browser, so a test or sandbox mode is a fair question for this product. The evidence documents no sandbox, test environment or dry-run mode that keeps production data isolated. Supervision prompts before sensitive actions and running actions locally in the browser are adjacent safety controls, not sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
